packageRules.description: Homebrew/actions uses 4-component calver tags (e.g. 2026.08.03.1), but Renovate's pin-comment parser only reads 3 components, so a SHA-pinned ref gets currentValue '2026.08.03'. loose versioning makes that value valid, and extractVersion truncates release tags to the same 3-component form so digest lookups resolve against a real release instead of failing.

x-ray bumps come from the native homebrew manager, which parses the tag-based url, tracks github-tags (upstream stopped publishing GitHub releases after v0.3.5; v0.4.0 is tag-only), and computes the new tarball sha256 by downloading it. A github-releases regex customManager was removed here because its digest lookups only resolve tag commit SHAs, not archive sha256s, which caused 'Could not determine new digest for update' warnings.
